fields.v: Yes (1): 'Threats, scalability, generalizability' paragraph names N=1, single developer, single platform and domain, individual-skill, post-hoc, survivorship and Hawthorne risks, single-rater regex and descriptive proxies; limitations also stated per observation and for artifact availability
fields.quote: Threats, scalability, generalizability. N=1, single developer, single platform (Claude Code), single domain: individual-skill, post-hoc, survivorship, Hawthorne risks apply; maintenance-class is single-rater regex; line counts are descriptive proxies.
fields.why: Threats and limitations are explicitly discussed (labelled paragraph plus hedges on each observation), which arguably meets Q10 in full for a 4-page paper.
fields.doubt: O parágrafo 'Threats, scalability, generalizability' (pág. 4) lista várias ameaças (N=1, um só programador, plataforma e domínio, riscos post-hoc, Hawthorne, etc.) e cada observação tem limitações. Noutro artigo de 4 páginas deste lote deste Sim a uma secção breve. Decide entre Parcial e Sim.
